title: What capital outlay is spent on
sourceIndicatorId: selected capital outlay components as share of total capital outlay, 2023-24 Account

metadata.publication: RBI State Finances: A Study of Budgets, 2025-26
metadata.method: Selected non-overlapping Appendix-4 capital outlay component Account values divided by total capital outlay for All States/UT in 2023-24. Other capital outlay is the residual.
caveats: All States/UT aggregate has a scope break: UTs are excluded from 1990-91 to 2016-17, except NCT Delhi is included from 2000-01 to 2004-05; from 2017-18 it covers all states and UTs.
2023-24 Account is the latest full actual year in the workbook. 2024-25 is Revised Estimate and 2025-26 is Budget Estimate.
Capital outlay is an accounting flow. It is not a measure of completed infrastructure, asset quality, or project timeliness.
The named components are selected for readability; Other capital outlay groups the remaining Appendix-4 capital heads.
